headline: MP to build awareness of Labour Codes with Shram Samvad
summary: The Ministry of Labour and Employment and the Madhya Pradesh government jointly hosted an awareness programme, Shram Samvad, to educate industry stakeholders on the new Labour Codes and compliance requirements. Held in Dewas with over 100 industry representatives, the initiative focused on clarifying statutory obligations and promoting key government social-security schemes.

headline: Suman Saurav takes charge as head-HR at Hindustan Zinc’s Debari operations
summary: Hindustan Zinc has appointed Suman Saurav as head of HR for its Zinc Smelter Debari and Central Research and Development Laboratory. Saurav, who previously served as deputy CHRO at the Debari facility, brings a background combining technical operations and human resources management from his prior roles at Hindustan Zinc and Bharat Aluminium Company. His experience spans industrial relations, labor compliance, and plant operations.

headline: Qantas plans to cut 850 jobs
summary: Australian airline Qantas plans to eliminate approximately 850 corporate positions as part of a multi-year technology partnership with Accenture aimed at modernizing internal systems and expanding AI adoption. The restructuring, scheduled to begin in mid-2027, will outsource key corporate functions in finance, HR, procurement, and marketing largely to teams in India. Qantas intends to consult affected employees and unions while exploring options for retraining and redeployment.

headline: Why professionals keep applying for jobs they don’t want
summary: Driven by career anxiety, fears of automation, or workplace boredom, professionals are increasingly engaging in "doomjobbing"—compulsively applying for roles they do not truly intend to accept. Enabled by low-friction AI tools and one-click applications, this habit creates significant fatigue for both job seekers and recruiters without fostering real career progress. Experts advise employees to focus on reskilling and seeking organizational clarity rather than using passive job applications to cope with uncertainty.

headline: UK moves towards mandatory pay transparency in job ads
summary: The UK government plans to introduce legislation requiring employers to disclose salary details in job advertisements to increase recruitment transparency. Supported by 93 per cent of surveyed businesses, the policy aims to narrow gender pay gaps and help jobseekers make informed career decisions. The initiative aligns with broader youth employment goals, supported by private sector commitments such as Siemens Mobility offering 10,000 work-experience placements.

headline: Apple cuts employee AI spending limits
summary: Apple has implemented stricter daily spending caps on artificial intelligence tools for its employees in an effort to manage rising technology costs. The reduced allowances affect both engineering and non-engineering staff, who are now being encouraged to utilize cheaper or locally run AI models. This shift reflects a broader tech industry trend moving from unrestricted AI experimentation toward tighter cost control and resource oversight.
